result.instructions: Tools for SHOPLINE, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are paid but not yet fulfilled?"; "Show me the products that changed this week."; "List the customers who signed up in the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SHOPLINE data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shopline_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shopline_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shopline_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shopline_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shopline_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in the store, newest first, with title, status, variants and images. Filter by ids, handle, status or creation/update time. Admin REST API: GET /products/products.json (scope read_products).

page_info.description: Cursor from next_page_info of the previous result. Gets the next page.

ids.description: Comma-separated ids to fetch, for example 4201825024,4201825025.

handle.description: Product handle (the URL slug), for example multi-color-stitching-dress.

status.description: Product status filter, as the SHOPLINE Admin defines it.

tools.name: shopline_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with their payment status, fulfillment status, totals and line items. Filter by ids, financial or fulfillment status, search text, or creation/update time. Admin REST API: GET /orders.json (scope read_orders).

page_info.description: Cursor from next_page_info of the previous result. Gets the next page.

financial_status.description: Payment status filter, for example partially_refunded or refunded.

fulfillment_status.description: Fulfillment status filter, as the SHOPLINE Admin defines it.

search_content.description: Free text to search orders for.

tools.name: shopline_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List store customers with their contact details and account data. Filter by ids or creation/update time. Admin REST API: GET /v2/customers.json (scope read_customers).

page_info.description: Cursor from next_page_info of the previous result. Gets the next page.

ids.description: Comma-separated ids to fetch, for example 4201825024,4201825025.
